index.html.title: Short-Term Rentals for Sale | Buyer Research & Due Diligence
index.html.description: Research short-term rentals for sale, verify seller evidence and prepare purchase questions. Compare acquisition support and scope before committing to a property.
index.html.heading: Prepare the evidence before choosing an STR to buy
index.html.body:
Start with the buying framework and seller booking and revenue verification. Separate recorded history, future reservations and modeled estimates; compare full operating costs and a downside case.

This is buyer research, not confirmation that a particular property remains for sale. Review the BNB Accelerator buyer guide and acquisition scope and fees before discussing your property buy box.
